r: jagajjAlapAlaM kanatkaMWamAlaM SaraccaMdraPAlaM mahAdEtyakAlam . naBonIlakAyaM durAvAramAyaM supadmAsahAyaM Baje'haM Baje'ham .. 1 ..
ay: jagat jAla pAlam kanat kaRWam Alam Saraccandra PAlam mahAdEtya kAlam naBas nIla kAyam durAvAram Ayam supadmA sahAyam Baje ham Baje ham

r: sadAMBoDivAsaM galatpuzpahAsaM jagatsannivAsaM SatAdityaBAsam . gadAcakraSastraM lasatpItavastraM hasaccAruvaktraM Baje'haM Baje'ham .. 2 ..
ay: sas dAmBas aDivAsam galat puzpahAsam jagat sannivAsam Sata Aditya BAsam gadA cakra Sastram lasat pItavas tram hasat cAruvaktram Baje ham Baje ham

r: ramAkaMWahAraM SrutivrAtasAraM jalAMtarvihAraM DarABArahAram . cidAnaMdarUpaM manojYasvarUpaM DftAnekarUpaM Baje'haM Baje'ham .. 3 ..
ay: ramA akaRWa hAram Sruti vrAt asAram jala antar vihAram DarA BAra hAram cid AnandarUpam manojYa svarUpam DftAn ekarUpam Baje ham Baje ham

r: jarAjanmahInaM parAnaMdapInaM samADAnalInaM sadEvAnavInam . jagajjanmahetuM surAnIkaketuM trilokEkasetuM Baje'haM Baje'ham .. 4 ..
ay: ja rAjat mahInam parAnanda pInam samADAna lInam sadA evAs navInam jagat janma hetum surAs nIka ketum triloka eka setum Baje ham Baje ham

r: kftAmnAyagAnaM KagADISayAnaM vimukternidAnaM harArAtimAnam . svaBaktAnukUlaM jagadvfkzamUlaM nirastArtaSUlaM Baje'haM Baje'ham .. 5 ..
ay: kftAm nAya gAnam KagAs DI SayAnam vimuktes nidAnam harA arA atimAnam sU aBakta anukUlam jagat vfkzamUlam nirasta Arta SUlam Baje ham Baje ham

r: samastAmareSaM dvirePABakeSaM jagadbiMbaleSaM hfdAkASaveSam . sadA divyadehaM vimuktAKilehaM suvEkuMWagehaM Baje'haM Baje'ham .. 6 ..
ay: samasta amareSam dvirePAs Ba keSam jagadbimba leSam hfdA AkASa veSam sadA divyadeham vimuktA Kile ham suvE kuRWa geham Baje ham Baje ham

r: surAlIbalizWaM trilokIvarizWaM gurURAM garizWaM svarUpEkanizWam . sadA yudDaDIraM mahAvIravIraM BavAMBoDitIraM Baje'haM Baje'ham .. 7 ..
ay: su rAlI balizWam trilokI varizWam gurURAm garizWam svarUpa eka nizWam sadAs yudDa DIram mahAvIra vIram Bava amBoDi tIram Baje ham Baje ham

r: ramAvAmaBAgaM talAlagnanAgaM kftADInayAgaM gatArAgarAgam . munIMdrEssugItaM surEssaMparItaM guROGEratItaM Baje'haM Baje'ham .. 8 ..
ay: ramA vAm aBAgam talAs lagna nAgam kftA aDInayA gam gata arAga rAgam munIndrEs sugItam surEs sam parItam guROGEs atItam Baje ham Baje ham

r: idaM yastu nityaM samADAya cittaM paWedazwakaM kaMWahAraM murAreH . sa vizRorviSokaM DruvaM yAti lokaM jarAjanmaSokaM punarviMdate no .. 9 ..
ay: idam yas tu nityam samADA aya cittam paWet azwakam kaRWa hAram murAres sa vizRos viSokam Druvam yAti lokam jarAs janma Sokam punar vindate no
